technical.summary: Bullish structure with EMA golden cross and three white soldiers, but overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R) and negative MACD histogram limit conviction; suitable for moderate-risk swing entry with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: WRB shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 65 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (3+ years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with VIX in crisis territory (396.64), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar headwinds, and credit stress; earnings in 65 days adds moderate event risk to already hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden cross and three white soldiers form bullish structure with price near support (40.7865), offering defined risk entry with technical confirmation in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 396.64, inverted yield curve, credit stress), zero fundamental support, overbought oscillators, negative MACD, and earnings event risk in 65 days overwhelm technical setup in hostile market regime.
